text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Casual Metal Planter and Stand, 20.87"H, Cement Gray and Gold
Materials: Metal
This casual planter in cement and gold tones can stand on the floor or on a table to house your favorite plant or fairy garden. The cement-toned planter brings a subtle wash of color to your room, while the open gold stand adds visual interest. 9.84" diameter x 20.87"H 100% iron This casual cement-hued planter in a gold-toned stand looks great with most decors. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
